item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Analysis of SMC waste for qualification for recycling processes (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-15 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-04 Chimica industriale

The ultimate objective of the REACT-FIBER project is to develop, validate and demonstrate at pilot scale an integrated, industrially scalable technological supply chain for the high-value recycling of Carbon Fiber Sheet Molding Compound (CF-SMC) materials. The activities planned under this assignment relate to OR2: Analysis of the quality of carbon fibers recycled from SMC, with particular reference to: • A2.1 – Optimization of carbon fiber recycling from cured SMC • A2.2 – Assessment of the feasibility of extending the recycling process to uncured scrap

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of Biomimetic and Edible Nanozyme for the Ultrasensitive and Selective Determination of Glucose (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The research activity will focus on the development and characterization of biomimetic and edible nanozymes with catalytic activity toward glucose oxidation, to be integrated into electrochemical platforms for its ultrasensitive and selective determination. In particular, nanomaterials with enzyme-like activity will be developed, also through the use of biocompatible and naturally derived components, and their integration into edible conductive formulations will be investigated. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: IR N. 2 ISOF BO_Development, Characterization, and Validation of Advanced Materials for Water Treatment and the Removal of Emerging Contaminants (CNR - Istituto per la sintesi organica e la fotoreattività)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto per la sintesi organica e la fotoreattività, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-03 Chimica generale e inorganica

The research will focus on the design, synthesis, and characterization, as well as the experimental validation, of molecular and/or 2D materials and technologies based on them for water treatment. The activities will include the development and optimization of advanced materials, as well as the evaluation of their effectiveness in removing emerging contaminants and of their stability and durability.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-17-chimica - Photoinduced approaches for the valorization of bioplastics under metal-free conditions (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The research program involves: 1) the study of photoinduced processes for the valorization of bioplastics under metal-free conditions; 2) the development of photoorganocatalyzed processes for the modification of the backbone of bioplastic materials; 3) the implementation of processes for the controlled depolymerization of bioplastic materials mediated by bio-based catalysts.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Novel Photocatalytic Strategies for Organoboron Chemistry - 2026_IDR_DCMC_22 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The project aims to develop innovative photocatalytic strategies for the sustainable synthesis of organoboron compounds (OBCs), fundamental in organic chemistry and crucial for the pharmaceutical and materials sectors. Since traditional methods based on carbanion chemistry are poorly sustainable, an efficient and eco-compatible approach driven by visible light is proposed. Photocatalysis grants access to open-shell intermediates under mild conditions, a reactivity suited to boron substrates, whose vacant p orbital favours radical stabilisation. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non-conventional sustainable solvents (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

Recovery and/or upcycling of organic material from rechargeable battery electrodes using non‑conventional sustainable solvents aims to establish low‑impact processes for selectively extracting, purifying, and revalorizing polymeric binders, conductive additives, and organic degradation products from spent electrodes. The project will design tailored deep eutectic solvents and maximize solubilization efficiency while preserving molecular integrity. Advanced spectroscopic analysis and electrochemical characterization will guide optimization of extraction pathways. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Evaluation of the effects of exposure to environmental contaminants in complex biological systems (Univ. BASILICATA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 23:59
Institution: Univ. BASILICATA, Potenza
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The project will focus on the study of the effects induced by exposure to environmental contaminants in complex biological systems, with the aim of understanding the cellular and molecular mechanisms associated with the risk of chronic diseases. The activities will include sample preparation and treatment, the analysis of biological responses under different experimental conditions, and the evaluation of biochemical and metabolic alterations induced by exposure.
